entities.name: Redundant PDU session establishment
entities.description: Procedure for establishing redundant PDU sessions where the 5GSM sublayer may support establishment of redundant PDU sessions as specified in 3GPP TS 23.501.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: Message used by UE to request establishment of a PDU session, which can include parameters for redundant PDU sessions.

entities.name: PDU session pair ID
entities.description: Information element that identifies a pair of redundant PDU sessions, included in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message.

entities.name: RSN
entities.description: Redundancy Sequence Number information element included in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message for redundant PDU sessions.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that can establish redundant PDU sessions by including PDU session pair ID, RSN, or both in establishment requests.

entities.name: SMF
entities.description: Session Management Function that receives PDU session pair ID, RSN, or both and handles PDU sessions as redundant according to 3GPP TS 23.501.

entities.name: URSP or UE local configuration
entities.description: Condition where UE sets PDU session pair ID, RSN, or both according to URSP (UE Route Selection Policy) or UE local configuration.

entities.name: Neither PDU session pair ID nor RSN provided
entities.description: Condition where UE provides neither PDU session pair ID nor RSN in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message, but SMF can still handle sessions as redundant.

relations.description: Redundant PDU session establishment procedure involves sending PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST messages.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message can contain PDU session pair ID information element.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST message can contain RSN information element.
UE sets PDU session pair ID, RSN, or both according to URSP or UE local configuration.
SMF receiving PDU session pair ID operates as specified in 3GPP TS 23.501 for redundant PDU sessions.
SMF receiving RSN operates as specified in 3GPP TS 23.501 for redundant PDU sessions.
SMF can handle two PDU sessions as redundant even if UE provides neither PDU session pair ID nor RSN.
